title: Complete character-option and core-rule pack semantics
description:
Complete the deterministic semantics of choices/variants, class features and
feats, ancestry/background/equipment grants, and rule/action/condition
procedures.

Cross-cutting root cause: mutually exclusive behavior is flattened into
unconditional arrays or hoisted to a parent record, so a consumer must infer
whether sibling values are additive, alternative, conditional, or
variant-specific. It must never have to infer that.
acceptance_criteria:
- Selecting one option grants only that option's complete behavior; sibling alternatives are never interpreted as cumulative.
- Every deterministic feature/feat/ancestry/background/rule clause is option-local, level-aware, executable, and linked to required engine capabilities.
- No phantom resource exists — a resource is emitted only when a source clause establishes it.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
